metrics.title: Squad Metrics
metrics.note: Rank 0–100 compares this squad with {n} reference squads of a similar budget. Estimated from card tables; a curated set of skills and armor is counted, vehicle weapons and other skills are not yet.
metrics.ranged_fire_desc: Expected Hostiles killed or pinned per turn at Range 1–2.
metrics.close_assault_desc: Expected Hostiles killed or pinned per turn in the same Location (weapons, grenades, hand-to-hand).
metrics.anti_armour_desc: Kill rate against high-Cover Hostiles (Cover 6+): armour, vehicles.
metrics.demolition_desc: Expected hits on a structure from the squad's explosive attacks.
metrics.supplies_desc: Share of the squad's firepower that lasts the whole mission (ammo, reloads, one-shot items).
metrics.mobility_desc: Share of the squad's Actions left after moving everyone to the objective and refilling hands.
metrics.survivability_desc: Hostile hits the squad absorbs: Health against Terrain Cover, plus bodies.
metrics.resilience_desc: How well the squad keeps working after losing its best soldier: spread of firepower, Player Soldiers, morale skills.
metrics.experience_desc: Starting XP plus Combat Experience (free Action cards each turn).
gen.title: Squad Generator
gen.subtitle: Give it a nation and a mission — or nothing at all — and it builds a squad from the cards you own.
gen.collection_only: only cards from these expansions are used
gen.nation_hint: Nations you own at least one Player Soldier for (in brackets).
gen.objective_hint: Random picks one that fits the mission.
gen.surprise: Nothing chosen — it will pick a nation and a mission too.
gen.players_hint: Number of Player Soldiers wanted. Auto follows the budget.
gen.q_optimal_hint: The best squad the engine finds. Same inputs, same squad.
gen.q_good_hint: Close to the best, with seeded variety: each seed gives a different squad.
gen.twist.interesting_hint: Shifts what the mission rewards, so a different kind of squad comes out.
gen.twist.challenge_hint: Deliberately imperfect: spends only 80 % of the budget.
gen.twist.one_hero_hint: One Player Soldier, the rest NPS / Squad Soldiers.
gen.twist.all_squad_hint: Squad Soldiers only, besides the Player Soldiers.
gen.twist.light_spender_hint: Spends at most 70 % of the budget.
gen.emphasis_hint: Nudges one metric up and one down from what the objective asks.
gen.vehicle_hint: Vehicle weapons are not evaluated yet, so vehicles are chosen on Health only.
gen.include_hint: Soldiers or weapons. Cards you do not own are ignored.
gen.seed_hint: The same inputs and seed give the same squad.
gen.empty_text: The generator only uses cards from the expansions you own.
gen.empty_1: Pick a nation and a mission, or leave them on Random.
gen.empty_2: Open Scenario, Style or Constraints to steer it.
gen.empty_3: Press Generate squad, then save it or open it in the builder.
gen.fitness_tip: How well the squad fits this mission and objective (0–100): metric ranks weighted by what the objective rewards, reduced by failed checks.
gen.lock: Lock: keep this card when regenerating
gen.lock_hint: Lock cards you like, then press Regenerate — locked cards stay.
gen.check.route: {moves} moves to the objective in {time} turns.
gen.check.explosive: Explosive attacks: about {have} expected hits, {need} needed.
gen.why_ps: {name}: Health {hp}, Movement {mv}, Loadout {load} for the cost.
gen.built_from: Built only with cards from {n} of your expansions:
gen.engine_note: Engine v0: greedy search. It picks weapons, a curated set of skills and armor, and cheap support soldiers. Optimal means the best this version finds.
gen.err.NO_PLAYER_SOLDIER_OWNED: Your expansions have no Player Soldier for this nation. Check My Expansions.
gen.err.MISSION_NOT_PLAYABLE: That mission or objective cannot be played with your collection and nation.
gen.err.BUDGET_TOO_LOW: The mission budget does not cover the cheapest Player Soldier you own.
